messages:
Devon (PM): Heads-up 1: we need a quick policy pick for the Priority Throughput add-on. Core questions: do we enforce a hard per-route cap (throttle) or soft cap with overage billing? Also packaging: single flat add-on vs tiered credits. Need launch criteria and contract language.
Priya / Sales: Sales prefers soft cap + overage invoicing. Easier to sell; customers hate sudden throttles. We can price tiers: Starter (10k tkn/mo), Scale (100k), Enterprise (custom).
Luis (Finance): Overage billing complicates revenue recognition but is manageable. We need clear invoice cadence and sample P&L impact. Also suggest a minimum monthly commitment for Scale tier to reduce volatility.
Sam (Eng Ops): Throttling is technically simplest to implement and predictable for infra. Overage requires meters, billing pipeline changes, and dispute handling. If we do soft caps, recommend meter + spike protection (circuit breaker) to avoid abuse.
Tessa (Legal): If overage billing, we need explicit "usage and overage" clause in SOWs: how disputes are handled, refund policy, and grace windows. Draft snippet: "Overage charges are invoiced monthly and payable per standard terms; customer may dispute charges within 30 days."
billing-bot: Note: meter-exporter v2 has per-route counters but billing adapter needs a migration. Estimated dev effort: 2 sprints.
Priya / Sales: Proposal from field: offer default soft-cap tiers for Hosted, but for Dedicated/Private we offer contractual hard caps or reserved throughput guarantees. That aligns with enterprise expectations.
Devon (PM): Trying to reconcile. Compromise candidate: default product = tiered credits with soft caps + automated invoice overage; for Dedicated/Private, require explicit cap selection in contract (can be hard throttle or reserved throughput with SLA). Pilot for enterprise: reserve tiers with option to enable throttling instead of invoice for emergencies.
Luis (Finance): If we do soft caps + overages, need these launch items: billing adapter tested in staging, sample invoices, revised revenue recognition playbook, and a list of dispute workflows. Also thresholds for write-offs.
Sam (Eng Ops): Launch criteria for infra: meter validation (end-to-end), spike protection policy, dashboarding for per-route usage, and a rollback plan (feature flag to disable overage billing).
Tessa (Legal): I'll prep a contract addendum template for reserved throughput and for overage billing opt-in. Also add language for migration path if customers move from soft cap to hard cap.
Priya / Sales: Field messaging suggestion: "Tiered Priority Throughput add-on with optional reserved capacity for enterprise customers. Soft caps billed monthly; reserved capacity available via contract."
Devon (PM): Action items: 1) Sam/Luis scope billing work and estimate effort (due Tue), 2) Tessa drafts two short clauses (overage + reserved throughput) by Wed, 3) Priya gather 3 customer asks/examples to validate tier thresholds, 4) I will write the product spec PR with rollout checklist. Decision to ship soft-cap tiers by default and reserved contract options for Dedicated/Private targeted for next quarter. :shipit:
